new_entities.name: Rear flat face of headform impactor

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be located in the geometric centre of the sphere with a tolerance of ± 5 mm
obligations.ears: The centre of gravity of the headform impactor including instrumentation shall be located in the geometric centre of the sphere with a tolerance of ± 5 mm.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: covered with a 14 ± 0.5 mm thick synthetic skin, which shall cover at least half of the sphere
obligations.ears: The sphere shall be covered with a 14 ± 0.5 mm thick synthetic skin, which shall cover at least half of the sphere.

derived.text: The sphere shall be covered with a 14 ± 0.5 mm thick synthetic skin.
The synthetic skin shall cover at least half of the sphere.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: allow for mounting one triaxial or three uniaxial accelerometers within ± 10 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the measurement axis, and ± 1 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the perpendicular direction to the measurement axis
obligations.ears: A recess in the sphere of the adult headform impactor shall allow for mounting one triaxial or three uniaxial accelerometers within ± 10 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the measurement axis, and ± 1 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the perpendicular direction to the measurement axis.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: have its sensitive axis perpendicular to the mounting face A (see Figure 19) and its seismic mass shall be positioned within a cylindrical tolerance field of 1 mm radius and 20 mm length
obligations.ears: When three uniaxial accelerometers are used, one of the accelerometers shall have its sensitive axis perpendicular to the mounting face A (see Figure 19) and its seismic mass shall be positioned within a cylindrical tolerance field of 1 mm radius and 20 mm length.

derived.text: When three uniaxial accelerometers are used, one of the accelerometers shall have its sensitive axis perpendicular to the mounting face A (see Figure 19).
When three uniaxial accelerometers are used, the seismic mass of that accelerometer shall be positioned within a cylindrical tolerance field of 1 mm radius and 20 mm length.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: run perpendicular to the mounting face and its mid-point shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor
obligations.ears: The centre line of the tolerance field shall run perpendicular to the mounting face and its mid-point shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: have their sensitive axes perpendicular to each other and parallel to the mounting face A and their seismic mass shall be positioned within a spherical tolerance field of 10 mm radius
obligations.ears: When three uniaxial accelerometers are used, the remaining accelerometers shall have their sensitive axes perpendicular to each other and parallel to the mounting face A and their seismic mass shall be positioned within a spherical tolerance field of 10 mm radius.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor
obligations.ears: The centre of the tolerance field shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.ears: The instrumentation response value CFC of the adult headform impactor, as defined in ISO 6487: 2002, shall be 1,000.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.ears: The CAC response value of the adult headform impactor, as defined in ISO 6487: 2002, shall be 500g for the acceleration.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.ears: The first natural frequency of the headform impactor shall be over 5,000 Hz.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: A rear flat face shall be provided on the outer surface of the headform impactors which is perpendicular to the direction of travel, and typically perpendicular to the axis of one of the accelerometers as well as being a flat plate capable of providing for access to the accelerometers and an attachment point for the propulsion system
obligations.ears: The headform impactors shall be provided with a rear flat face on the outer surface which is perpendicular to the direction of travel, and typically perpendicular to the axis of one of the accelerometers as well as being a flat plate capable of providing for access to the accelerometers and an attachment point for the propulsion system.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: meet the performance requirements specified in paragraph 8
obligations.ears: The headform impactors shall meet the performance requirements specified in paragraph 8.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: may be used for a maximum of 20 impacts before re-certification
obligations.ears: The certified headform impactors may be used for a maximum of 20 impacts before re-certification.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.ears: When more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification or the transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC, the impactors shall be re-certified.

derived.text: When more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification, the impactors shall be re-certified.
When the transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC, the impactors shall be re-certified.
